subject: Unit start job begun
description: A start job for a unit has begun execution.

subject: Unit start job succeeded
description: A start job for a unit has finished successfully.

subject: Unit start job failed
description: A start job for a unit has failed.

subject: Unit stop job begun
description: A stop job for a unit has begun execution.

subject: Unit stop job finished
description: A stop job for a unit has finished.

subject: Unit failed
description: A unit has entered the failed state.

subject: Process killed by the OOM killer
description: A process belonging to a unit was killed by the kernel's out-of-memory killer.

subject: Session created
description: A new login session has been created for a user.

subject: Session terminated
description: A login session has been terminated.

subject: Time change
description: The system clock has been changed, either manually or via time sync.

subject: Journal started
description: The systemd-journald service has started and begun collecting log data.

subject: Journal stopped
description: The systemd-journald service has been stopped.

subject: Journal messages suppressed
description: Log messages from a service have been suppressed due to rate limiting.
